text:
maria-sec: Auditor asked for evidence mapping that ties RBAC changes, KMS use, and any vuln triage notes to controls. What's our thin canonical manifest for artifacts?
devon-ops: We keep a single-line JSON index per artifact in the delivery bundle. Fields: key, incident, control, type, ts, collector, env, deploy, kms_key, checksum.
auditor-kate: please show a single example line so we can map to our control spreadsheet. also include whether artifact contains prod PII.
maria-sec: example (one-liner in the index file):
```
{"key":"audit/2026-03-21/INC-512/rbac-change-commit.log","incident":"INC-512","control":"AC-4","type":"iam_change_log","ts":"2026-03-21T09:14:02Z","collector":"infra-ci","env":"prod","deploy":"a1b2c3d","kms_key":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01","checksum":"sha256:9f86d081884c7...","pii":"no"}
```
auditor-kate: perfect. for KMS we also need the key policy reference and when the key was rotated. can you include key_policy_id and key_rotation_ts if available?
devon-ops: yes we can pull key metadata from KMS API and append key_policy_id + last_rotation_ts to the index entry. for HSM-backed keys we will put hsm_key_ref instead.
maria-sec: request from compliance: when RBAC changes are made via terraform, include the PR url and commit hash on the manifest so we can trace to review comments.
auditor-kate: that helps. also we want a 30-day sample window around the incident, plus 1 baseline sample in the previous quarter.
oncall-bot: export job started: export-evidence INC-512 window=2026-02-19:2026-03-22 format=zip job_id=exp-512-20260321 status=running
devon-ops: note re: vuln triage artifacts  we include Jira ticket id and vuln severity in the manifest entry for any artifact coming from vuln response buckets (fields: vuln_ticket, vuln_severity).
auditor-kate: for incident response artifacts, do you include chain-of-custody records showing who pulled the evidence and when?
maria-sec: yes, delivery bundle will include chain_of_custody.csv (columns: artifact_key, exported_by, export_ts, reason, ticket_ref).
auditor-kate: acceptable. preference: raw logs where feasible; screenshots of dashboards ok only as supplement. checksums + presigned links with expiry are mandatory.
devon-ops: presigned_url_parent CSV will have presigned_url, presigned_expires_days. default expiry 7 days but we can extend per request.
oncall-bot: exp-512-20260321: 28 artifacts packaged, generating presigned links. ETA ~1m
maria-sec: small ask  for RBAC changes captured by k8s audit logs, include a short human-readable "description" field in the manifest (e.g., "rolebinding change: added svcacct X to admin"). auditor-kate: yes add description and data_sensitivity (prod/dev/contains_pii).
devon-ops: final proposed index columns CSV for you: artifact_key, presigned_url, checksum, checksum_algo, collected_ts, incident, control, type, description, data_sensitivity, collector, env, deploy, pr_url, commit, kms_key, key_policy_id, key_rotation_ts, vuln_ticket, vuln_severity, exported_by, export_ts, ticket_ref
auditor-kate: great. one more: for any encryption proofs include the envelope key id and whether envelope-wrapping was used (field: envelope_key_id, envelope_wrapped true/false).
maria-sec: ack. we'll add envelope_key_id/envelope_wrapped. timeline: can we deliver the CSV + zipped artifacts by EOD PST?
devon-ops: yes, exp-512-20260321 complete and uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-shipments/INC-512/ . CSV attached in bundle.
auditor-kate: received the package, starting review. if I find mapping gaps I'll post specifics here. thanks. :wave:
maria-sec: thanks team. leaving note to update the evidence playbook to include these manifest fields and a sample export script snippet.
